title: Blackjack hand value
hints: Score the hand as if every Ace is 11 first, then fix it up.
Write a `points(card)` function with a `match` that has one `case` per card class: `case Number(n, _): return n`, and `case Jack() | Queen() | King(): return 10`. Sum the hand and count the Aces.
While the total is over 21 and you still have an Ace counted as 11, subtract 10 and count one fewer Ace. A `while` loop does it.

answer.explain: The reference scores each card with a `match` on its class (Aces as 11), sums the hand, counts the Aces with `isinstance`, then softens: while the total is over 21 and some Ace is still worth 11, it subtracts 10. Two Aces become 12, not 22 or 2.
